verdict.rationale: TruffleHog is an official CLI (probe-4) that runs non-interactively via brew or Docker (gh-1, gh-2, gh-6). It supports config-file driven scans and detector flags (docs-14, docs-7, docs-21), plus a `--fail` flag for gating automation (docs-13). It also documents pre-commit and pre-receive hook automation (docs-5, docs-16, docs-19, docs-30). Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline integration docs (e.g. GitHub Actions/GitLab CI), evidence of machine-readable (JSON) output for downstream automation, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.
